attack.frontal.twin_rail.desc: Corvette twin-rail volley: light dorsal and ventral rails snap-fire in sequence - two rapid hits, damage split evenly.
attack.frontal.precision_lance.desc: Frigate precision lance: a high-velocity focused beam snap-fires with minimal spread - one crisp hit for full damage.
attack.frontal.heavy_volley.desc: Battleship heavy volley: three staggered cannon ports fire in a rolling burst - three cluster hits, damage split evenly.
attack.frontal.prime_beam.desc: Super Carrier prime beam: a capital-scale sustained energy lance projected muzzle→target, holding until the impact tears through.
attack.broadside.slipstream.desc: Corvette slipstream strafe: ship warps through a slipstream portal to a firing position near the target, unloads twin-mount streams, then warps home.
attack.broadside.plasma_salvo.desc: Frigate plasma salvo: ship holds position and fires five heavy white plasma shots in sequence, each landing with a bright shockwave before the next launches.
attack.broadside.sweeping.desc: Cruiser sweeping barrage: ship swivels its broadside across TWO adjacent enemies, splitting the volley between them for equal-share damage.
attack.broadside.iron_roar.desc: Battleship lithium broadside: ship braces back on recoil and unloads six massive slow rounds with heavy smoke trails and thunderous impacts.
attack.broadside.deluge.desc: Super Carrier deluge bombardment: every port opens simultaneously, raining 10-12 arcing shots that curve down onto target in a cluster.

ground_attack.Rifle Volley.desc: Standard small-arms fire. Balanced damage, normal counter-fire.
ground_attack.Marksman's Shot.desc: A single aimed round. +40% damage against any unit with a general attached.
ground_attack.Suppressing Fire.desc: Dense volume of fire - 75% damage but the target's counter-fire is halved.
ground_attack.Main Gun.desc: Standard AP shell. Balanced damage against any target.
ground_attack.HE Shell.desc: High-explosive round. +35% damage vs Infantry, -20% vs Tank.
ground_attack.Sabot Round.desc: Kinetic penetrator. +35% damage vs Artillery, ignores 25% of Tank DEF.
ground_attack.Point-Blank Shell.desc: Adjacent fire, 130% damage - but the target CAN return fire.
ground_attack.Suppression Barrage.desc: Long-range indirect fire at 65% damage. Target cannot return fire.
ground_attack.Airburst Shell.desc: Splits at apex. 85% to primary target, 40% splash to one adjacent enemy. No counter.
city.tier.1.desc: A frontier outpost anchoring a small workforce. Boosts planetary income by 2%.
city.tier.2.desc: A growing township whose markets and services buoy every resource stream. Boosts planetary income by 5%. Requires the outpost's population cap to have been reached before upgrading.
city.tier.3.desc: A civic municipality with denser infrastructure and a broader tax base. Boosts planetary income by 10%. Requires the township's population cap to have been reached before upgrading.
city.tier.4.desc: A major city hub, its logistics and administration amplifying every industry on the planet. Boosts planetary income by 15%. Requires the municipality's population cap to have been reached before upgrading.
city.tier.5.desc: A sprawling metropolis with full services and strategic influence - the apex of civilian output for a world. Boosts planetary income by 20%. Requires the city's population cap to have been reached before upgrading.
city.upgrade.max_level_desc: Maximum city level reached. This settlement has achieved full development and provides maximum resource generation and population capacity.
city.upgrade.in_progress_desc: City upgrade in progress. Please wait for completion.

attack.resource_transfer.desc: Transfer 50% of HP and shields to heal another ship.
